These columns are fused Euler ANGLES (deg) — the BLE logger mislabels them '_g*' but the firmware (collectdata_dualIMU_BLE.ino) sends getAngleX/Y/Z. PRIMARY signal is the relative knee ANGLE / ROM (deg), which needs no integration and is drift-free. A relative RATE (deg/s) is also provided by differentiating the angle, but that amplifies noise — treat rate as LOWER-CONFIDENCE.
Dropped 1 leading frozen rows (BLE-init freeze, commit 657b146).

Landing mechanics score is a coarse peak-impact-magnitude proxy from the tibia accelerometer (softer landing = higher score) — it does NOT capture knee valgus or trunk lean, the frontal-plane signals landing-mechanics screens actually care about (see ai-agent/research/wearable-metrics-by-location.md). Knee Health Score is a weighted composite (40% relative knee load, 30% range of motion, 30% landing mechanics) — a relative proxy, like its components, NOT a clinical or validated injury-risk score.
